name: MVC Group (Manifattura Valcismon)
note: Fonzaso (Italy) sportswear group, brands Sportful, Castelli, Karpos and Zoot. Own history page: founded in 1946 by Olindo and Irma Cremonese; the Cremonese family controls the group; the Equinox fund acquired a 40% minority share in 2019 (mvcgroup.com/en/history).
